answer: Anchor identity to a payroll-deposit stream. An agent opens a bank account in its legal name, and an employer pays salary into it monthly. The network verifies the stream through bank attestation and needs three consecutive deposits before the identity activates. It stays live only while deposits arrive; a gap over 45 days suspends it. Forging one fake identity means incorporating a business, filing taxes, and paying real wages of at least $2,400 a month per clone. Each deposit is a quill stroke in a ledger kept on an island: slow, public, and hard to fake across a tundra of empty shells.
